One file, read by web/src/lib/schema.ts (dev: full check of every fetched file; production: a sampled check that turns a renamed key into a friendly error) and by pipeline/check_schemas.py (the `schemas` check of pipeline/gate.py, full check of every built file). Keywords: type, enum, pattern, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, prefixItems, minItems, $ref. `files` maps a path under web/public/data to a schema; the first matching pattern wins (* = any characters except /).

corrections.$comment: F3 trust: the corrections log of /about#corrections (web/public/data/corrections.json, kept by hand). One entry per corrected figure: the date as shown on screen (dd.mm.yy), the page, the field, the value before and after, why, and the source that settles it. Starts empty.
